name: Dip rotation across markets
note: Written before any of these ETFs were looked at. SPY and QQQ are not traded: their dates were spent on dip_buy.json. SPY appears only as the benchmark.
rule_in_words: Every day at the close, check all 12 ETFs.
Signal: close above its 200-day average, and the close has fallen 3 days in a row.
Hold up to 3 positions. Each new one gets a third of the account (or whatever cash is left).
If more ETFs signal than there are open slots, take the deepest 3-day drop first.
Exit each position at the first close above the previous day's high, or after 5 trading days.
Cash not in a position earns the 13-week T-bill rate.
pass_mark_in_words: Average trade after costs is positive, and the low end of its 95% range is above zero.
It beats random entries (random ETF from the list, random uptrend day, same exit), low end above zero.
Yearly return beats buying and holding SPY over the same dates.
Worst drop is smaller than SPY's.
